messages:
Maya Patel: taking primary now for the night shift, I’ll be on until 22:30 PT. Leaving quick notes: KV-cache has been noisy, p99 latency spikes up to ~800ms in the last hour, request queue depth briefly hit 120. Andre is secondary. If you get paged, triage order: autoscaler -> prefix warmup -> model fallback. Runbooks pinned below. :wave:

Andre Gomez: ack. thanks. do we know if this correlates with the deploy that started ~20m ago?

Maya Patel: there was a small model variant rollout at 21:40 PT in us-east-1 (canary), ops-bot showed 10% nodes in the canary cohort. I saw the spike before the rollout finished, but timing is close. linking runbooks: https://console.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-degradation and https://console.redwood/runbooks/primsec-evac-guide

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: kv-cache-high-latency (p99 > 500ms) — impact: generation latency increase. Pager URL: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-2265

Andre Gomez: on it — first checks:
1) `kubectl get hpa -n inference` -> confirm autoscaler not throttled
2) check `redis-kv-*` pod restarts: `kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=redis-kv -o wide`
3) look at recent runtime logs for `kv_cache.py`

Priya Singh: FYI customer-facing metric: error rate is still flat, but tail latency affects interactive flows. If regen latency > 1s we should consider rolling fallback to cached model variant or temporarily reduce batch_max_size.

Andre Gomez: ran step 1/2, autoscaler shows Desired=10 Current=6 (scaling lag). HPA throttling events in metrics: yes, saw a couple of `failed to allocate` around 21:47. Pod spin-up slower than usual.

Andre Gomez: logs (snip):
```
2026-03-15T21:48:12Z kv_cache WARNING eviction_loop slow_take 0.34s
2026-03-15T21:48:37Z runtime ERROR kvcache miss_rate 0.72
2026-03-15T21:49:04Z infra WARN node-provisioner timeout provisioning slot
```
Maya Patel: thanks. immediate remedies: 1) bump HPA max to 20 for the group (temporary) -> `kubectl patch hpa kv-layer -n inference --patch '{"spec": {"maxReplicas": 20}}'` 2) trigger prefix warmup against hot keys for the top 50 prefixes (script below) 3) if autoscaler still lags, flip traffic to us-west fallback pool (see routing playbook)

Priya Singh: also put a short-term model-fallback: route traffic to `text-gen-medium-quant` variant to reduce per-token CPU, route is `route:v1/runtime/primary` -> can do a canary rollback to 0% then 100% if needed. Console quick link: https://console.redwood/routes/v1/runtime/primary/rollout

Andre Gomez: executed HPA bump. Starting warmup script (kicked with `./tools/warmup_prefixes --top 50 --concurrency 8`). Watch `prefix_warmup` metric.

ops-bot: Deployment detected: rollout `release/2026.3.15-21-3` paused at 30% (affected service: redis-kv-sidecar). Pause reason: increased error rate observed by deploy-bot.

Jordan Lee: quick note — if we end up evacuating primary, follow `primsec-evac-guide` steps: mark primary read-only, switch primary token to secondary, update external routing rules, and notify support with templated message (link in runbook). Keep me posted.

Andre Gomez: warmup shows warmup_hit_ratio trending up from 0.12 -> 0.46 after ~90s. Autoscaler current=12 now. p99 down from 800ms -> 420ms.

Maya Patel: great. keep monitoring for 15m. If p99 stays <500ms and queue depth <40 -> handback looks clean. Otherwise we proceed with model fallback and region failover plan. Adding quick checklist here:
- HPA bump command (done)
- Warmup script (running)
- Pause rollout in console (ops-bot shows paused)
- If fallback needed: route -> `text-gen-medium-quant` (Priya)
- Customer comms (Jordan)

Andre Gomez: agreed. I’ll stay as secondary until 22:00 PT. Maya, if you need to step out earlier ping me and I’ll escalate to Jordan. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: handing off monitoring to Andre now. Leaving a final note: if you need the one-liner message for support when there’s visible customer impact: `Customer impact: elevated generation latency (p99 ~800ms) observed in us-east, mitigation steps applied: autoscaler bump, cache warmup, paused canary rollout. Next actions: fallback to medium quant model if p99 > 600ms for 10m.`

Andre Gomez: acknowledged. monitoring -> alerts set to critical -> slack notify on channel #incidents and page on repeat 2m. signing in.

Maya Patel: thanks team — handing off. :wave:
